newsitem.title: USA: Winnebago no comment on shr activity - NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Winnebago no comment on shr activity - NYSE.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange on Thursday said Winnebago Industries Inc declined comment after it asked the company if there were any developments that might be related to the unusual market activity in its shares.
"The company stated that its policy is not to comment on unusual market activity or rumors," the NYSE said.
The NYSE declined to comment further on the market activity in the company's stock.
Winnebago shares were up 1-1/4 at 8-7/8 early Thursday afternoon. By 1330 EDT/1730 GMT, about 211,000 shares had changed hands, compared with a daily average of about 56,700.
